name: @somemore/mobile
description: Native shell configuration for Some More. See README.md — the ios/ and android/ projects are generated, not committed.

scripts.add:ios: npx --yes @capacitor/cli@8.5.0 add ios && npm run assets
scripts.add:android: npx --yes @capacitor/cli@8.5.0 add android && npm run assets
scripts.sync: npm run build --workspace @somemore/web && npx --yes @capacitor/cli@8.5.0 sync && npm run assets
